chartSql.borough_weekend_filter: SELECT "BOROUGH_NAME" AS "BOROUGH_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", AVG("TIP_RATE") AS "TIP_RATE" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_BOROUGH_DAY" WHERE "IS_WEEKEND" = true GROUP BY "BOROUGH_NAME" ORDER BY "TRIPS" DESC
chartSql.hour_zone_heatmap: SELECT "HOUR_OF_DAY" AS "HOUR_OF_DAY", "ZONE_NAME" AS "ZONE_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS" FROM "PEAK_HOUR_DEMAND"."BY_HOUR_ZONE_DAY" WHERE "SERVICE_ZONE" IN ('Yellow Zone', 'Airports') GROUP BY "HOUR_OF_DAY", "ZONE_NAME" ORDER BY "TRIPS" DESC LIMIT 200
chartSql.hourly_profile: SELECT "HOUR_OF_DAY" AS "HOUR_OF_DAY", "DAYPART" AS "DAYPART", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", AVG("AVG_FARE") AS "AVG_FARE" FROM "PEAK_HOUR_DEMAND"."BY_HOUR_DAY" GROUP BY "HOUR_OF_DAY", "DAYPART" ORDER BY "HOUR_OF_DAY" ASC
chartSql.kpi_totals: SELECT SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", SUM("FARE_AMOUNT") AS "FARE_AMOUNT", SUM("TIP_AMOUNT") AS "TIP_AMOUNT", SUM("TOTAL_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_AMOUNT" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_DAY"
chartSql.od_distance_filtered: SELECT "SERVICE_ZONE" AS "SERVICE_ZONE", SUM("TRIP_DISTANCE") AS "TRIP_DISTANCE" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_OD_DISTANCE" WHERE CAST("ZONE_NAME" AS VARCHAR) ILIKE 'JFK%' ESCAPE '\' GROUP BY "SERVICE_ZONE"
chartSql.od_pairs_rollup: SELECT "ZONE_NAME" AS "ZONE_NAME", "DO_ZONE_NAME" AS "DO_ZONE_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", AVG("AVG_FARE") AS "AVG_FARE" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_OD_DAY" GROUP BY "ZONE_NAME", "DO_ZONE_NAME" ORDER BY "TRIPS" DESC LIMIT 25
chartSql.payment_mix: SELECT "PAYMENT_TYPE_NAME" AS "PAYMENT_TYPE_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", SUM("FARE_AMOUNT") AS "FARE_AMOUNT", AVG("TIP_RATE") AS "TIP_RATE" FROM "FARE_COMPOSITION"."BY_PAYMENT_DAY" WHERE "DAY_ID" >= DATE '2024-02-01' AND "DAY_ID" < (DATE '2024-02-29' + INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY "PAYMENT_TYPE_NAME"
chartSql.rate_code_table: SELECT "RATE_CODE_NAME" AS "RATE_CODE_NAME", "WEEKDAY_NAME" AS "WEEKDAY_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", SUM("FARE_AMOUNT") AS "FARE_AMOUNT", SUM("TOTAL_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_AMOUNT" FROM "FARE_COMPOSITION"."BY_RATE_CODE_DAY" GROUP BY "RATE_CODE_NAME", "WEEKDAY_NAME" ORDER BY "FARE_AMOUNT" DESC LIMIT 50
chartSql.revenue_by_month: SELECT date_trunc('month', "DAY_ID") AS "DAY_ID", SUM("TOTAL_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_AMOUNT", AVG("AVG_FARE") AS "AVG_FARE" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_ZONE_DAY" GROUP BY date_trunc('month', "DAY_ID")
chartSql.top_zones: SELECT "ZONE_NAME" AS "ZONE_NAME", "BOROUGH_NAME" AS "BOROUGH_NAME", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", AVG("REVENUE_PER_TRIP") AS "REVENUE_PER_TRIP" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_ZONE_DAY" GROUP BY "ZONE_NAME", "BOROUGH_NAME" ORDER BY "TRIPS" DESC LIMIT 10
chartSql.trips_by_day: SELECT date_trunc('day', "DAY_ID") AS "DAY_ID", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", SUM("TOTAL_AMOUNT") AS "TOTAL_AMOUNT" FROM "DAILY_ZONE_PERFORMANCE"."BY_DAY" WHERE "DAY_ID" >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND "DAY_ID" < (DATE '2024-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY date_trunc('day', "DAY_ID") ORDER BY date_trunc('day', "DAY_ID") ASC
chartSql.vendor_daily: SELECT "VENDOR_NAME" AS "VENDOR_NAME", date_trunc('week', "DAY_ID") AS "DAY_ID", SUM("TRIPS") AS "TRIPS", SUM("AIRPORT_FEE") AS "AIRPORT_FEE" FROM "FARE_COMPOSITION"."BY_VENDOR_DAY" GROUP BY "VENDOR_NAME", date_trunc('week', "DAY_ID") ORDER BY date_trunc('week', "DAY_ID") ASC
